The '''Prison dialect of Kessel''' was spoken by those [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] sentenced to a prison term on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]]. In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] discovered a [[Lorrd Artifact|tasseled artifact]] that was composed of many languages, among them the prison dialect of Kessel.
